verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers share issuance, EMI/growth/unapproved scheme setup, exercising options, cap tables, and communications, but nowhere describes defining custom vesting schedules with cliffs, milestones, or exit-acceleration, nor automatic vested/unvested tracking. Missing for 10: any documentation of vesting schedule configuration, cliff/milestone logic, acceleration-on-exit handling, or automated vested-vs-unvested calculation.
